concepts.gloss_en: Torah novellae / original Torah insights (generic, unqualified)

members.note: base construct form; generic usage in lm1:13, lm1:54

concepts.gloss_en: The Torah novellae that a person innovates (in lm1:118 equated with the aspect of Mashiach)

members.note: construct + relative clause 'that he innovates'; specific lm1:118 usage tied to Mashiach/ruach — kept apart from bare noun per under-merge and rule 4 (qualified phrase ≠ bare head)

concepts.gloss_en: The Torah novellae that are revealed (lm2:60, RaShbY/R. Akiva context)

members.note: identical phrase in same Torah (lm2:60), same referent; differs only by definite article on התורה within the construct — not an archetype case, same context

notes: Three relative-clause forms kept separate from the bare noun and from each other by Torah/verb: שמחדש (lm1:118, 'innovates', Mashiach) vs שמגלין (lm2:60, 'reveal'). The two lm2:60 forms differ only by the definite article on התורה in the same passage and are merged. Did NOT merge שמחדש with שמגלין despite semantic closeness — different Torahs, different verbs; under-merge preferred.
